review_evidence: README identifies Pantograph as a machine-to-machine interaction system exposing Lean frontend, proof execution, expression construction, environment inspection, REPL, and FFI interfaces.

A complete proposition-file scan found theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations only in PantographTest/Frontend/{Collect,Distil,Refactor}.lean, PantographTest/Integration.lean, PantographTest/Proofs.lean, and PantographTest/Tactic/Fragment.lean.

Production Pantograph modules define protocol data, goal/environment manipulation, frontend/refactoring, serialization, elaboration, and tactic execution APIs; no independently proved semantics or mathematical theory is developed there.

source_action.content_invariant: Complete source inspection separates production protocol/frontend/tactic implementation from PantographTest; all proposition-bearing declarations are confined to the test corpus, so retirement removes no independent mathematical theorem/proof or proved Pantograph semantics.
